main.description: Moves a thread to another channel by rewriting the channel its record links to. Who may read the thread follows the new channel. The anchor is left as it was, so the thread's marker leaves the old channel's river while the thread itself still quotes the message it came from.

channel.description: The text channel to move it to.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the thread.manage permission.

errors.name: ThreadNotFound
errors.description: No thread matches the given space reference.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.description: No channel matches the given space reference.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The destination channel belongs to another community, is not a text channel, or is the channel the thread is already in.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
